ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels comprising approximately 90% of the visible surface area, with high-intensity (white) pixels concentrated at the distal tips and in small isolated clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous dark pigmentation field across the majority of the fluke surface; localized high-contrast white geometric blobs situated at the distal tips of both left and right lobes; small isolated white pixel groups scattered sparsely across the medial lobe regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible U-shaped depression with an approximate calculated angle of 130-140 degrees; central apex is partially obscured by splash-induced water cavitation but the primary geometric boundaries are identifiable.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Moderate frequency serrations along the continuous linear boundary; pixel-amplitude of peaks and valleys ranging from 5 to 20 pixels, with higher complexity observed on the distal third of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Distinctly convex curve originating from the notch and transitioning into a tapered, slightly upward-curving trajectory towards the distal fluke tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible white, roughly circular high-contrast pixel clusters on the leading and distal margins of both fluke lobes, corresponding to localized surface scarring or colonization.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small irregular nicks and indentations along the trailing edge, particularly visible as distinct breaks in the continuous contour on the left lobe.
